Revenue in 2024 Q3 was **$8,461,841.81**.

The Midwest decline was caused primarily by **Halloway Group not renewing at the end of the previous quarter**. The review says Halloway was the Midwest region’s largest account by revenue, and its departure was the **single largest driver** of the decline. It also says the commercial team attributed the loss to **a competitor’s national framework agreement**, not service failure.
